mapper.sql: select dc.case_id, dc.task_id, rt.title as task_title, dc.plaintiff_id, up.nick_name as plaintiff_name, up.avatar as plaintiff_avatar, dc.defendant_id, ud.nick_name as defendant_name, ud.avatar as defendant_avatar, dc.reason, dc.plaintiff_description, dc.defendant_description, dc.plaintiff_evidence_images, dc.defendant_evidence_images, dc.status, dc.handler_id, uh.nick_name as handler_name, dc.handle_reason, dc.handle_time, dc.create_by, dc.create_time, dc.update_by, dc.update_time from dispute_case dc left join reward_task rt on dc.task_id = rt.task_id left join sys_user up on dc.plaintiff_id = up.user_id left join sys_user ud on dc.defendant_id = ud.user_id left join sys_user uh on dc.handler_id = uh.user_id
mapper.select: where dc.task_id = #{taskId} order by dc.create_time desc
mapper.insert: insert into dispute_case (task_id, plaintiff_id, defendant_id, reason, plaintiff_description, plaintiff_evidence_images, status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time) values (#{taskId}, #{plaintiffId}, #{defendantId}, #{reason}, #{plaintiffDescription}, #{plaintiffEvidenceImages}, #{status}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{updateBy}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: select case_id, task_id, plaintiff_id, defendant_id, reason, plaintiff_description, defendant_description, plaintiff_evidence_images, defendant_evidence_images, status, handler_id, handle_reason, handle_time, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from dispute_case where case_id = #{caseId}
